note: 13D/A du 2023-02-09 : lettre d'intention non contraignante du 7 février 2023 de SoftBank Group Corp. pour racheter Berkshire Grey à 1,30 $ par action, payée sur sa trésorerie ; aucune arête
quote: On February 7, 2023, SoftBank delivered a non-binding letter (the "Indication of Interest") to, the Chief Executive Officer of the Issuer, in which SoftBank proposed to, directly or via an affiliate, purchase all of the outstanding capital stock of the Issuer at a per-share price of $1.30 (the "Potential Transaction").
